text: The most specific price wins.
prefix: The most specific price wins.

text: The bank's fee works the same way.

text: Here is how it works.
prefix: Here is how it works.

text: A fee rule is one price the bank sets.
prefix: A fee rule is one price the bank sets.

text: It can apply to one website, one merchant, one card, or the whole bank.
prefix: It can apply to one website, one merchant, one card, or the whole bank.

text: When a payment arrives, the most specific rule wins.
prefix: When a payment arrives, the most specific rule wins.

text: A website's own rule beats its merchant's rule.
prefix: A website's own rule beats its merchant's rule.

text: A merchant's rule beats a card's rule.
prefix: A merchant's rule beats a card's rule.

text: And the bank's default is used only when nothing more specific applies.
prefix: And the bank's default is used only when nothing more specific applies.

text: The fee itself is a percent of the amount, plus a fixed part.
prefix: The fee itself is a percent of the amount, plus a fixed part.

text: It is kept between a minimum and a maximum.
prefix: It is kept between a minimum and a maximum.

text: Money is always counted in whole cents, never in fractions of a cent.
prefix: Money is always counted in whole cents, never in fractions of a cent.

text: So the percent is rounded once, to whole cents, and the sum is exact.
prefix: So the percent is rounded once, to whole cents, and the sum is exact.

text: Rules are never edited in place.
prefix: Rules are never edited in place.

text: A change is proposed by one admin, and a second admin approves it.
prefix: A change is proposed by one admin, and a second admin approves it.

text: Two rules for the same thing can never apply at the same moment: the database itself refuses an overlap.
prefix: Two rules for the same thing can never apply at the same moment: the database itself refuses an overlap.

text: And every payment keeps the rule it used, its fee, and what the merchant receives.
prefix: And every payment keeps the rule it used, its fee, and what the merchant receives.
